docs/poc/API_CONTRACT.md:664:Mock `listNotifications`, `updateNotification` and `readAllNotifications` share one recipient/workspace/accessible-parent projection, also used by Bootstrap badges. Deleted or mismatched parents and private inaccessible projects contribute neither rows nor counts nor mutations; accessible archived history remains readable. Source Inbox excludes `update` from its unread badge, while Notifications counts every unread type. The list cursor records `(createdAt,id)` and filter/principal scope; changing an anchor's read state does not skip the next page. Read/read-all are idempotent persisted operations with server-clock timestamps and no undo history.
docs/poc/API_CONTRACT.md:666:Inbox and Notifications use one Query key for all paginated records and canonical `getTask` queries. Read mutations optimistically update that key and Bootstrap, guard rollback by cache identity, then invalidate both notification and bootstrap scopes. Inbox replies, mentions and reactions use the existing task Comments operations/cache. Attachments stay at the Source-supported Drawer composer opened by Open task. Notification preferences and transport remain assigned to their existing later owners.
docs/poc/API_CONTRACT.md:671:`getMember` reads a workspace membership, distinct from its `userId`; `getMemberSummary` and shared task/activity queries validate the active principal and canonical membership. Counts/tasks/projects exclude unauthorized private parents, archived/deleted parents/tasks and foreign workspace references. Activity uses the canonical newest-first read order and active actor/parent guards. Source directory `visibleProjects()` omitted `canSee()` and counted private p6 for Marcus/Lena; canonical counts deliberately exclude that record. Source profile `allTasks()` already checks project visibility: this is not a profile task-count leak.
docs/poc/API_CONTRACT.md:673:`PeopleDemoAdapter` owns a versioned `task8.demo.people.v1:<workspaceId>:<principalId>` directory projection. It receives canonical membership/team/capability context from complete read queries and Bootstrap; commands cannot supply their own allowed team list. Invite validates normalized deduplicated email/role and authoritative workspace team, adds pending **demo metadata**, and never creates an account, sends email, changes API identity, grants project access, or unassigns tasks. Role/resend/remove/Undo use the same demo state and canonical active Owner/Admin guard; Owner/current membership stays read-only. Storage failure and version/Undo conflicts preserve the previous state. `deactivated` is presentation only; canonical MemberDto remains active|invited.
docs/poc/API_CONTRACT.md:675:The directory projection is cached by TanStack Query. No HTTP operation silently falls back to demo: profile/list/session API errors remain visible and their Retry refetches the queries that failed. Demo success copy states that no email was sent; removal copy states that account access, permissions and tasks remain unchanged. Canonical new-task assignment and completion/Undo continue through existing task operations with membership IDs. Demo pending/deactivated entries cannot be assigned a real task. Settings reuses exported people components at WU24; Teams commands/body remain WU21.
